items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, well we took, and I took Yank and played.

ctx.x: Yeah, you see his name was Oliver I believe. No. Oh, what that boy name is. Uh-uh. You remember when the, when the, when they had Paducah in them up there, Yank was learning playing horned in. When the, Sweevers would come here and played, uh. Played ball. Played. Car Lake and them up there. You know. Yank was playing. Playing horned in. On that horned in.

Well I know, I know because, I know but Yank playing cause he followed us from, everywhere we went playing Yank was with it. Yeah. Yeah. Came Chook on. Yeah, yeah. And after, after he got so great he beat Chook. Chook died afterwards. Yeah. Yeah, well we took, and I took Yank and played. Yeah. I played with it for you, Yank. Was Yank older or younger than Buddy? No, he was younger than Buddy. Younger than Buddy. Younger than Buddy.
Yank was younger. Yank was older than me. Yeah. Yank was older than me.
